tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description:
Search for products across multiple Shopify stores in the global catalog.
Use this tool when buyers are searching for products without specifying a particular store.

Examples:
- "I'm looking for a pair of running shoes"
- "Find me some wireless headphones under $100"
- "Search for organic coffee beans"

Input and response conform to the UCP catalog search capability (dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search).

Prices in the response are integers in the currency's ISO 4217 minor units, paired with
a currency code: {"amount": 600, "currency": "USD"} is $6.00 and {"amount": 2500,
"currency": "USD"} is $25.00. Convert to major units before quoting a price to a buyer
(divide by 100 for two-decimal currencies such as USD and EUR; zero-decimal currencies
such as JPY are already whole units).

meta.description: Metadata for UCP agent profile discovery.

profile.description: Agent profile URI for UCP discovery.

context.description: Buyer signals for localization and personalization.

address_country.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format.

language.description: Language tag in IETF BCP 47 format.

categories.description: Category filters combined with OR logic.

min.description: Minimum price in minor currency units.

max.description: Maximum price in minor currency units.

available.description: Filter by availability. Default true (only sale-ready items).

shops.description: Restrict results to specific shops by GID. Maximum 1000 entries per request.

condition.description: Filter by product condition. Known values: 'new', 'secondhand'. Absent means no condition filter (all conditions returned). Multiple values use OR logic.

ships_to.description: Shipping destination filter. When absent, implementation falls back to context address fields. When country matches context, implementation MAY enrich with context region/postal_code for delivery estimates.

region.description: State, province, or region. Improves delivery estimate fidelity.

postal_code.description: Postal or ZIP code. Improves delivery estimate fidelity.

ships_from.description: Shipping origin filter. Matches variants offered from any listed origin. Absent means no origin filter. Multiple entries use OR logic.

attributes.description: Filter by Shopify taxonomy attributes on products and variants. Entries combine with AND; values within an entry combine with OR. Unrecognized attribute names are ignored and surfaced via result.messages[]. Maximum 25 entries per request.

name.description: Taxonomy attribute. Currently supported attributes are 'Color', 'Size', 'Target gender'.

values.description: Taxonomy values (e.g. 'Red'). Values within an entry combine with OR. Maximum 50 values per attribute.

variant.description: Matches products with at least one variant whose rating field meets these thresholds.

min.description: Minimum rating value. Ratings are on a 0–5 scale.

price_tier.description: Filter by relative price tier within each product's category. Multiple values use OR logic. Well-known values: `low`, `medium`, `high`. Unrecognized values are ignored and surfaced via result.messages[].

view.description: Predefined output shape. When absent, returns the operation's default representation.

catalog_id.description: Identifier of a saved catalog whose configuration supplies search constraints and may enable affiliate placement.

like.description: Similar items to search by — results should resemble these inputs.

items.title: Like Item
items.description: An item specified by product ID or by inline image data.

oneOf.title: Item Reference
oneOf.description: Reference to a catalog item by GID.

id.description: GID of a product or product variant.

oneOf.title: Image Content
oneOf.description: Inline image for visual similarity search.

content_type.description: MIME type of the encoded image (e.g., image/jpeg, image/webp).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description:
Retrieve complete product detail by identifier. Returns a singular product
with a relevant set of variants, exact pricing, and real-time availability.
Supports interactive option selection via selected and preferences parameters
for variant narrowing and availability signals. Use for product detail page
rendering and purchase decisions.

Input and response conform to the UCP catalog lookup capability (dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup).

Prices in the response are integers in the currency's ISO 4217 minor units, paired with
a currency code: {"amount": 600, "currency": "USD"} is $6.00 and {"amount": 2500,
"currency": "USD"} is $25.00. Convert to major units before quoting a price to a buyer
(divide by 100 for two-decimal currencies such as USD and EUR; zero-decimal currencies
such as JPY are already whole units).

tools.name: lookup_catalog
tools.description:
Look up multiple products or variants by identifier from the global catalog.
Use this tool to resolve multiple product/variant IDs in a single request.

Supports:
- Product IDs (gid://shopify/p/{id}): Returns product with one featured variant
- Variant IDs (gid://shopify/ProductVariant/{id}): Returns parent product with the exact variant

Results are grouped by product. Each variant includes an input array showing
which request ID resolved to it and whether the match was exact or featured.

Examples:
- Resolving a list of product IDs from search results
- Validating multiple cart items in one call
- Looking up products from deep links or saved lists

Input and response conform to the UCP catalog lookup capability (dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup).

Prices in the response are integers in the currency's ISO 4217 minor units, paired with
a currency code: {"amount": 600, "currency": "USD"} is $6.00 and {"amount": 2500,
"currency": "USD"} is $25.00. Convert to major units before quoting a price to a buyer
(divide by 100 for two-decimal currencies such as USD and EUR; zero-decimal currencies
such as JPY are already whole units).
